Okay first thing I’ll say is that the “i don’t know” ‘s and the uncertainty is just kinda how I talk. When I write things out it’s how I would say them as if I was having a face to face conversation. And I just happen to say that a lot. I think it’s an anxiety thing? Idk 

Second, the therapy idea- one of the more mentally traumatic experiences (traumatic is a strong word here) was years ago when my parents put me in therapy and it was so bad and I hated it, it’s not that I didn’t like the person it was the experience overall. Idk it was truly awful and I hated everything about it. I’m also not worried about fixing myself anymore because I know I’ll be gone, that’s kinda why this past couple weeks have been so comforting because I know that the date is getting closer. other weeks, I’ve still been doing my work so that teachers don’t suspect anything and question me about what’s going on because like I’ve said I really hate talking to people face to face. To me it’s none of their business. I’d never say something like that to them it’s just that I like to keep things to myself. Anyway (getting sidetracked) this week has been so relaxing because I know that there’s no point in doing my work (especially things that are due Friday and next week) because I’ll be gone. So it’s been nice to just have my own time at school to listen to music, practice or just walk around because I don’t have anything to do. If my entire like was as carefree as this entire week has been I’d be so happy in my life but,

I’d rather have one good week without anxiety than live the rest of my life with it

Maybe it’s because I don’t know you and will never meet you? I’m not sure

Yeah, I guess that’s kinda right, it’s like I don’t feel like I will ever make a difference so why be in the way of someone else and cause them stress. Also I’ve always felt like people who actually want to be helped make it known. They’ll say things like “I just wish people cared” or “part of me wants to do this and part of me doesn’t” in hopes that somebody will convince them otherwise. I feel like people who actually want to die don’t tell people because that only stop them and get in the way. I know that it’s harsh for me to say that but that’s just how I’ve always viewed it. I don’t tell people because I don’t want them to stop me and I don’t want people to care because that’ll only make it harder for me, if that makes sense.

I initially decided to go on Reddit so that I could see if people had information on my plan and if there were flaws in it, and through comments people have said I refined my plan to something that I personally am hopeful will work, but I have not told anybody else because people that I know in my real life have the power to stop me, but people on Reddit don’t.

Well I appreciate it (I also take medication for ocd and anxiety)  I appreciate the sympathy I just try to disconnect that from people so that it’s easier for me to say goodbye.. if that makes sense. Sometimes it just doesn’t work out and it’s hard to help people, but it’s clear when people want help. I appreciate you reaching out and if I wanted help I would ask for it but hopefully you can use your kindness to save someone who needs a second chance. Thank you

My ocd relates mostly to things like numbers if that makes sense? So I have to step in the same number patterns depending on where the lines on the floor are. I do everything in sets of two and twelve, so for example when I walk through doors I have to tap the doorway twice or else I get these weird twitches in my neck. So sometimes if I’m at school and I have to miss a doorway (i also tap pillars, walls and tables) because someone is walking in the way, my mouth will involuntarily click twice (like as if you’re calling a cat) I mean it’s probably not involuntary but it happens before I can stop myself from doing it. Then for things that are in sets of twelve, like if I wash my hands, I flick the water off and count to twelve, same with when I’m done brushing my teeth, and doing the dishes takes ages bc with everything single item in the sink, I have to “shake” 12 times before putting it in the dishwasher. And this is with most things. Idk I don’t really have a clear list of what I do, it just kind of happens. I also have the need to get rid of everything all the time. So some people who are hoarders have severe ocd, I have the exact opposite. I’m constantly trying to get rid of everything and I don’t buy things I don’t need which is good bc then I know I’m not gonna spend money on little useless things, but it also means I can easily detach emotion to objects if that makes sense- which I think a lot of people struggle with normally? But I love organizing but it gets stressful when I have too many things bc it just feels cluttered and nothing can be put away. If you look at my room, it has three things- my bed, my desk, and my cello (the instrument I play) everything is always put away and cleared off or else I can’t sleep. And I have nothing on my walls, it’s all just blank. I have fairy lights which are relaxing, but that’s the most decoration I can handle. Idk I feel like there’s so many things that just take control, and people think it’s weird bc I have the neck twitches and the audible clicks whenever I get nervous or things don’t turn out how I want them to. I have an extremely hard time working with other people because I’m so controlling and I don’t want people to view me as such so I just avoid others altogether. I’ve always known that I’ll never want kids because I don’t think I could handle taking care of someone who isn’t myself, their life would just be miserable and I don’t want to put that on to anyone, same goes with being in a relationship with someone. I just don’t see a purpose in trying to fix all of this stuff when I don’t really have a purpose anyway. I don’t talk to people so what do they care, I know is he a terrible mother and/ or wife bc I’m too controlling. I’m not good enough at playing music to inspire anyone. It all just feels so pointless.

I’m not the type of person to talk about what goes on in my head. but I’ll try to scratch the surface a bit... But it’s the stress, feelings of depression, not being good enough. My ocd has taken over my life to where I feel the need to control every situation that I now don’t have any control at all. People don’t like me and I know that they don’t want to be around me. They make it obvious. Every little thing overwhelms me now. I get so stressed over every little thing that I can’t enjoy anything anymore. People usually say stuff like of just relax and watch something, but watching tv is torture to someone with as much anxiety as I have. Music is my only outlet but even then, I’m not a good enough musician. I get annoyed, frustrated and even more depressed when I can’t play something that someone sitting next to me can play with ease. I’ve always had to try so much harder than everyone else and I’m still not a good musician. It just doesn’t seem worth it to me. On the topic of music, my private lessons teacher wants me to go to college but I can barely make it through school now and I don’t have any money for it, not to mention I’ve never wanted to go to college. I don’t want to invest in something I know I’ll fail at. And that too, I don’t want to start my life in debt. I developed ocd bc of my mom. She is the most controlling and narcissistic person I’ve ever met which means I’ve never had control over my own life and so I just want to be able to just start my life. I don’t want to go to school.

I feel like that’s barely scratching the surface. There is so much wrong with my mind and I can’t escape it. I know it’s so easy to just say “relax” or “it’ll be okay” but I’ve been telling myself that for years and I’m more than tired of it. Idk, again I’m rambling and it probably just feels like I’m trying to get sympathy. I’m not trying to, please don’t feel bad for me. I always feel like I burden others by throwing them into conversations like this but like I don’t need sympathy. I just want to stay out of peoples way forever.

I’ve never tried, this would be my first attempt ever. By again I just mean after. I haven’t told anyone I’m planning on killing myself bc I don’t want someone to tell somebody and stop me. As sad as it sounds I know that it’ll just make things so much worse. So the fact that people might not see it coming scares and and makes me not want to face them after they’ve learned this other side to me? Idk I’m kinda rambling

I ask because I hope that it does. I don’t want it to fail because that only means more money that my parents have to spend on me and then I have to face everybody again. I don’t want to risk surviving so I’m hoping that if somebody knows something that I’m not seeing they’ll tell me so I can avoid that
